title: Fivefold Akam Love: The Third Stage of Physical Manifestations
paragraphs: As her dress gets loosened, She goes behind the fragrant creeper by the stream To adjust the clothes. Be it so that he would be her husband in future, Shyness prevents her from doing it under his gaze. The lustrous lass stands behind the creeper Loosens the attire all and rerobes it. She plaits the wear under the navel

And tucks it up Running her palm down to the hip. Just then A gush of strong wind snatches away her upper garment. Crossing her elbows over the chest And placing the fingers ten on the shoulders, She conceals her breasts As does one That hides the stolen lotus buds From the guards of the pond. These four Along with displaying non-existent strength, Constitute the bodily manifestations Of the third phase of love union. They then leave the rendezvous With two bodies but with hearts unseparated.

> The third phase of the clandestine love manifests in: > Her seeing her hips down off from exposure as the garments slip, > Correcting the waist-ornaments thereon, > Her pretence to be unassailed by slings of passion, > And her hands rising, her pretence notwithstanding.
